Name: Discourage implicit measures
Description: Numeric columns used in visuals should always have explicit DAX measures.
Expression: Model.DataModel.Tables.Any(t => t.Columns.Any(c => c.SummarizeBy != AggregateFunction.None && c.DataType != DataType.String && !c.IsHidden))

Name: Foreign keys must be hidden
Description: Columns on the many-side of relationships must be hidden from report view.

Name: Avoid Bi-directional relationships
Description: Relationships should use single cross-filtering to avoid ambiguity and performance traps.
